Because the custody account is separate, an attacker cannot recycle one pool of capital across 59 aliases, and each one needs its own funded zephyr account. A bond of 28% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 9 epochs. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
